question: Are we trying to restore one isolated app/tenant without touching the rest, or do we need global roles, permissions, and point-in-time disaster recovery across everything?
reference_answer: Clarify whether the tenant has its own database. A logical pg_dump covers a single database, with selective restore possible from an archive. Cluster-wide roles or other shared objects need separate handling such as pg_dumpall. For whole-cluster point-in-time recovery, use a physical base backup and an uninterrupted sequence of archived WAL. The documentation cannot determine the team's required recovery scope.
